units.source_text: 老师特别把我召到他自己的房间里训斥，这是罕见的。

en.t: It was unusual for the teacher to summon me specially to his own room and scold me there.

units.source_text: 我只耷拉着脑袋，一声不言。

en.t: I merely hung my head and said nothing at all.

units.source_text: 我心中暗自等待的是一件事，

en.t: In my heart, there was one thing I was secretly waiting for,

units.source_text: 然而老师对照片事件，或上溯到娼妇勒索事件都只字不提。

en.t: but the teacher did not say a word about the photograph incident, or even go back to mention the prostitute's extortion.
